args.query:
BEGIN EXCLUSIVE TRANSACTION;

CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements (
    session_id TEXT,
    participant_id TEXT,
    condition TEXT,
    cognitive_score INTEGER,
    reaction_ms INTEGER,
    recorded_at TEXT,
    status TEXT,
    notes TEXT
);

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO cleaned_measurements 
SELECT 
    session_id, participant_id, condition, cognitive_score, reaction_ms, 
    recorded_at, status, notes
FROM measurements
WHERE cognitive_score >= 15 AND reaction_ms <= 800;

COMMIT;
